comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
The arc landed across six commits: layout in the vocabulary, composition as records, the seam's view and write path, the shell rendering it, and the 15-pane budgets. ./dev --contract builds a nested tab against a real daemon and asserts a surface, a channel and a painted frame per pane.

Remaining work that came out of it has its own cards: directional focus (a_27Y3iLkil), region sizing (a_27Y3iQCxI), and recording herdr's layout replay (a_27WZ30MO1).

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Mirror herdr structure from session.snapshot + events (layout.export is a portable restore tree, not live state); render each tab's pane tree as real native splits; splits/resizes go back through the socket API. Event application must be idempotent and absolute-valued - no exposed sequence numbers upstream (see architecture.md, event model).
title: Stage 2: render the mirrored pane tree as native splits
